subject: Subcontracting notice — proposed subprocessor + DPA path for Order Form 4573
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Garrison <maya.g@acmepayments.com>, acct-success@acmepayments.com
Cc: carmen.rios@acmepayments-legal.com
Date: 2027-03-22T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Subcontracting notice — proposed subprocessor + DPA path for Order Form 4573

Hi Maya / ACME team,

Per Section 6.2 of our MSA (Order Form OFR-4573), I'm writing to notify you that Redwood plans to engage a third-party subprocessor, DataSync LLC, to provide nearline logging and metrics aggregation for the OFR-4573 integration. This is a supplier change that may require either a change notice or your written consent under the MSA.

Summary: 
- Subprocessor: DataSync LLC (US-based; AWS-hosted, managed service)
- Purpose: aggregated logs + anonymized metrics only (no PII in logs by design)
- Anticipated start: 2027-04-05

To accelerate review, attached: 
- Redwood_MSA_redlines_v3.docx — redline proposing a limited consent path for operational subprocessors
- Redwood_DPA_amendment_v1.pdf — proposed DPA amendment covering DataSync processing
- Vendor_List_annotated.csv — short vendor profile for DataSync

Request: can you confirm your preferred path: 
1) Provide written consent to DataSync as a subprocessor (we commit to flow-down DPA terms), or
2) Require execution of the DPA amendment + SOC2 / questionnaire materials prior to consent, or
3) Require removal (we'll propose alternatives).

If you prefer (2), we can provide the completed questionnaire and SOC2 attestation by EOD Thursday. If (1) is acceptable, please reply with consent language and we'll proceed to onboard. 

If helpful, I can loop in our legal team for any redlines.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redlines_v3.docx; Redwood_DPA_amendment_v1.pdf; Vendor_List_annotated.csv

From: Maya Garrison <maya.g@acmepayments.com>

Date: 2027-03-22T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subcontracting notice — proposed subprocessor + DPA path for Order Form 4573

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the heads up. A few quick asks so we can triage: 
- Full list of subprocessing activities and whether DataSync will have access to any token or key material (yes/no).
- Where is DataSync hosting located (region/country)?
- Copy of the subprocessor agreement or confirmation that the DPA will be flowed down verbatim.
- Updated security questionnaire (if available) + SOC2 Type II report or ISO attestation.

Please loop in Redwood legal — we'll need legal review before consenting. Our legal team is at legal@acmepayments.com.

For timing: we generally aim for confirmation within 5 business days once we have the docs.

Best,
Maya Garrison
Customer Success — ACME Payments
maya.g@acmepayments.com

Jordan — I reviewed the redlines and DataSync background. Proposed path (recommended):

1) Offer ACME a limited consent package: DPA amendment (attached), completed subprocessor questionnaire, and SOC2 Type II summary (we'll provide cert/access). This addresses the majority of legal concerns without heavy contract renegotiation.
2) Keep the MSA redline minimal: add a sentence clarifying that certain operational subprocessors may be added with written notice and an opportunity for ACME to request mitigation (not blanket consent).
3) If ACME requests further redlines to the MSA (e.g., prohibition on downstream subcontracting), escalate to Markus for approval of commercial concessions.

Attachments for outbound to ACME: Redwood_DPA_amendment_v1.pdf; Subprocessor_Questionnaire.xlsx

I do not recommend full removal unless DataSync can't provide SOC2 evidence. If they can't, we can propose a short delay and alternative vendor.

If that direction works, Jordan please send to ACME with the two attachments and copy legal. I'll be available for redlines if they push back.

-Laura

Jordan / Laura — thanks for the materials. ACME Legal can proceed on a limited-consent basis PROVIDED we receive the following before consent: 

1) Final executed DPA amendment (DocuSign link acceptable).
2) SOC2 Type II attestation or report (redacted is OK) and a completed Subprocessor_Questionnaire.xlsx with responses.
3) Confirmation that DataSync will not further subcontract any portion of this work without ACME's prior written consent (or, alternatively, a notification + 5 business day review window).

If Redwood can provide (1) + (2) + confirmation to (3) we will issue consent and do not expect further MSA negotiations. Please confirm timeline — ACME needs the documents by 2027-03-30 to meet our on-boarding window.

We will review upon receipt and aim to respond within 2 business days.

Carmen Rios
